title: Baadshah Hussain
body:
Baadshah Hussain
<<DIVIDER>>
hussain x2
<<MINI>>
badshaah hussain, hussain
badshaah hussain
<<DIVIDER>>
yeh deen panaahi ka sharaf kisko mila hai, yeh kiska laqab hai jo sare arsh likha hai
<<MINI>>
badshaah hussain, hussain
badshaah hussain
<<DIVIDER>>
Ajmer ke khwaaja ne yeh sach khoob kaha hai, laarayb k shabbir hi kalme ki baqa hai
<<MINI>>
badshaah hussain, hussain
badshaah hussain
shah ast hussain, badshah ast hussain
dee'n aat hussain, dee'n panah ast hussain
<<DIVIDER>>
sardaad na daad dast dar dast e yazeed
haqqa k bina laa ilaah ast hussain
<<MINI>>
badshaah hussain, hussain
badshaah hussain
karbobala ishq e khuda
ishq ka tu sultaan hussain
shah hussain, badshaah hussain
dee'n ast hussain dee'n panah ast hussain
<<DIVIDER>>
1. Maula bada kaam kiya, deen e khuda aam kiya, kar naa saka koi kabhi, tune wahi kaam kiya, waada wafa karke raha, sar na jhuka haq pe jiya, sabse bada mera khuda
karta rha ailaan hussain
<<MINI>>
shah hussain, badshaah hussain
dee'n ast hussain dee'n panah ast hussain
badshaah hussain, hussain
badshaah hussain
karbobala ishq e khuda
ishq ka tu sultaan hussain
<<DIVIDER>>
2. Ishq tera, ishqe khuda
noke sina tak jo gaya
ishq mei jo tune diya
koi bhi woh de na saka
<<DIVIDER>>
noor e khuda dast e khuda
tere siwa kaun hua
kehna pada likhna pada
hai yeh tera ehsaan hussain
<<MINI>>
shah hussain, badshaah hussain
dee'n ast hussain dee'n panah ast hussain
badshaah hussain, hussain
badshaah hussain
karbobala ishq e khuda
ishq ka tu sultaan hussain
<<DIVIDER>>
3. Sarwar e zeeshan hussain
azmat e insaan hussain
bolta qur'an hussain
main tere qurbaan hussain
<<DIVIDER>>
meer e haram rab ki kasam
tera yeh gham hoga na kam
farsh e aza haq ki sada
hai yeh tera faizaan hussain
<<MINI>>
shah hussain, badshaah hussain
dee'n ast hussain dee'n panah ast hussain
badshaah hussain, hussain
badshaah hussain
karbobala ishq e khuda
ishq ka tu sultaan hussain
<<DIVIDER>>
4. Azme jawaa'n tashnalaba
bewatana bekafana
tere liye hai yeh fugha
arsh o zameen nauhakuna
<<DIVIDER>>
dard e dilaa'n tashnadahaan
khush zabaa'n noke sina
tan se juda sar tha magar
padhta raha qur'an hussain
<<MINI>>
shah hussain, badshaah hussain
dee'n ast hussain dee'n panah ast hussain
badshaah hussain, hussain
badshaah hussain
karbobala ishq e khuda
ishq ka tu sultaan hussain
<<DIVIDER>>
5. haaan...
har jaaa'n hai huqumat teri
har dil mei basa hai
har dil mei azakhaana tera aaj saja hai
<<DIVIDER>>
quraan e masaaeb mei tera naam likha hai
matam ki sada hai ki yeh tu bol rha hai
ishq e khuda teri adaa
naam tera zinda raha
<<DIVIDER>>
karbobala di hai sada
tu hai bada insaan hussain
<<MINI>>
shah hussain, badshaah hussain
dee'n ast hussain dee'n panah ast hussain
badshaah hussain, hussain
badshaah hussain
karbobala ishq e khuda
ishq ka tu sultaan hussain
<<DIVIDER>>
6. haaan...
thi zinda azadaari teri zinda rahegi
woh qaum jo bedaar hai gham tera karegi
awaaze azaan jo tere rauze se uthegi
<<DIVIDER>>
wallah khudaayi teri aawaaz sunegi
shaahe zaman, hadi e mann
naaze chaman, sheeri sukhan
shaan e Nabi, shaan e Ali
<<DIVIDER>>
yaani meri jaan hussain
<<MINI>>
shah hussain, badshaah hussain
dee'n ast hussain dee'n panah ast hussain
badshaah hussain, hussain
badshaah hussain
karbobala ishq e khuda
ishq ka tu sultaan hussain
<<DIVIDER>>
7. Jannat e mann karbobala
rahat e mann karbobala
sarwar o rehan e aza
daulat e mann karbobala
<<DIVIDER>>
hum hai safeeran e aza
shah e huda tumpe sada
jaan karein tumpe fida
hai yeh mera armaan hussain
<<MINI>>
shah hussain, badshaah hussain
dee'n ast hussain dee'n panah ast hussain
karbobala ishq e khuda
ishq ka tu sultaan hussain
